intervention_names: Device: transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation
arm_groups.label: taVNS Plus Tirzepatide 5 mg

brief_summary: This is a single-center, randomized, participant-blinded, sham-controlled trial designed to evaluate the adjunctive effect of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) in overweight or obese patients who show a suboptimal weight-loss response to incretin receptor agonist therapy. A total of 24 participants will be randomly assigned to receive either taVNS plus tirzepatide 5 mg or sham stimulation plus tirzepatide 5 mg for 12 weeks. The primary objective is to compare the percent change in body weight from baseline to week 12 between the two groups.
brief_title: Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation for Poor Weight-Loss Response to Incretin Receptor Agonists

lead_sponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

official_title: Adjunctive Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Overweight or Obese Patients With a Suboptimal Weight-Loss Response to Incretin Receptor Agonists: A Single-Center, Randomized, Sham-Controlled Study

primary_outcomes.measure: Percent Change in Body Weight From Baseline

sites.facility: Department of Endocrinology, the Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School
